top_signals.title: Ousted Ukrainian defense chief lands Palantir CEO as first investor in new venture
top_signals.summary: Ukraine’s recently ousted defense minister Mykhailo Fedorov is teaming up with Palantir CEO Alex Karp to launch a new defense company.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: G20 finance leaders close talks marked by U.S. welcoming Russia
top_signals.summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the fact that nearly all participants agreed to a final statement suggested "there has been no impact" from Russia's attendance.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Seasonal ag truckers from Mexico face same English-language rules, DOL says
top_signals.summary:
H-2A visa status does not shield seasonal agriculture commercial drivers from English-language requirements or the possibility of roadside out-of-service enforcement, DOL says.

The post Seasonal ag truckers from Mexico face same English-language rules, DOL says appeared first on FreightWaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Why High Yields on Government Bonds Are Causing Alarm
top_signals.summary: Government borrowing costs have been surging around the world as investors demand more compensation to entice them to hold longer-maturity debt. A Bloomberg gauge tracking government debt across the G7 countries now yields its highest on average since September 2000. Michael MacKenzie reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
